CORE EXPLANATION

Modules organize visibility, while Cargo.toml stores dependencies and project metadata. cargo test runs tests, cargo fmt formats code, and cargo doc builds documentation.

Cargo.toml declares package metadata, versions, features, and dependencies; Cargo.lock records resolved versions for reproducible application builds. `cargo check`, `cargo build`, `cargo test`, `cargo fmt`, and `cargo clippy` serve different validation stages. A library crate exposes reusable code, a binary crate builds an executable, and a workspace coordinates related crates. Review version, license, maintenance, and target support before adding dependencies.
